description:
We are a team of curious minds, creative thinkers, and passionate about space, science, and innovation. We love turning interesting ideas into practical solutions and exploring how technology can help solve real-world challenges.

Our team brings experience in Full-Stack Development (React.js, Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB), Python, AI/ML, and problem-solving. We are excited to collaborate, experiment with new technologies, and build something impactful for the NASA Space Apps Challenge.
